extraction_policy.salary_interpretation: Gross monthly compensation in BDT (Consolidated Executive Grade salary plus field/sales allowances, TA/DA, performance bonuses, mobile allowances, PF, and gratuity) unless specified otherwise.

cross_source_insights.most_important_new_signal: ACI Agribusiness is the largest private-sector agricultural conglomerate in Bangladesh, organized into specialized Strategic Business Units (Crop Care, Motors, Seed, Animal Health, Fertilizer, Animal Genetics, Biotech). It offers an exceptional career bridge for Agricultural Economists, Agronomists, Data Analysts, and Ag-Engineers by combining R&D field stations with commercial sales, financing, and data-driven supply chain management.

highest_value_jobs_for_an_agricultural_e.job: Business Data Analyst / Commercial Operations Executive
highest_value_jobs_for_an_agricultural_e.why: Direct fit for Agricultural Economists with quantitative skills; drives seasonal input demand modeling, dealer credit risk scoring, and SBU-level revenue analytics.

highest_value_jobs_for_an_agricultural_e.job: Territory Manager / Territory Officer (ACI Crop Care)
highest_value_jobs_for_an_agricultural_e.why: Primary commercial entry point for B.Sc Agriculture graduates; provides direct exposure to farmer economics, pest management, and channel distribution.
High-value brand management role positioning nationwide crop protection and yield-booster brands.
Integrates agricultural economics with retail credit evaluation and hire-purchase financing for rural farmers.

insyt_corporate_product_opportunities.feature: Private Agribusiness vs Government Research Salary Comparator
insyt_corporate_product_opportunities.logic: Compare public research pay scales (BARI/BRRI Grades 9-10) against ACI corporate executive packages + incentive structures
Map academic knowledge against commercial field skills (IPM, dealer management, credit risk, S&OP)

critical_data_modeling_notes: ACI Agribusiness positions operate under a Strategic Business Unit (SBU) model; job titles must retain their SBU tag (e.g. ACI Crop Care vs ACI Motors vs ACI Seed vs ACI Animal Health).
Commercial roles (Territory Managers, Marketing Officers, Credit Officers) feature significant incentive components (TA/DA, sales commission, KPI bonuses) beyond basic salary scale.

Field locations are distributed nationwide across agricultural hubs (e.g., Bogra, Jessore, Mymensingh, Rangpur, Rajshahi), while strategic product management and data roles are HQ-based at ACI Centre, Tejgaon, Dhaka.
B.Sc Agriculture and Agricultural Economics candidates from institutions like Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU) are highly prioritized for executive tracks across ACI Agribusiness units.

source_traceability.ACI_AGRIBUSINESS: Aggregated from ACI PLC corporate career portal archives (aci-bd.com/career), official SBU recruitment notices, BDJobs ACI corporate listings, and ACI Agribusiness corporate releases.
